basic_info.description: Welcome to unit 650! This south-facing condo with balcony is super conveniently located near the elevator and offers gorgeous views of City Hall, Hayes Valley, Twin Peaks, and Sutro Tower. This fantastic one-bedroom, one-bath unit features new carpeting, fresh paint, a walk-in closet, and custom-built-ins for added convenience and additional storage room. Located in the highly desirable Opera Plaza, you'll enjoy an array of amenities, including a heated pool and spa, fitness center, and sports courts for basketball, racquetball, and pickleball, onsite management, concierge service, and 24 hour security. Centrally situated in the heart of San Francisco, this property is near great restaurants, coffee shops, transportation, and offers easy freeway access. Leased parking is also available. Opera Plaza offers a vibrant community with everything you need within reach. Whether you're enjoying the stunning city views from your balcony, taking advantage of the top-notch amenities, or exploring the lively neighborhood, Unit 650 provides the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.
